note: On the Tunnel Mountain bench above Banff, with a public transit stop to town. 85 of the electrical sites have firepits (starred on the campground map); 21 sites hold oTENTiks. Not designed for tent camping in summer. --Claude
summary: Keep. Year-round, 209 electrical sites (15/30/50 amp) to 40 ft at C$40; showers, flush toilets, dump and drinking water added; pin sits in the Village II loops.

Note: 'short walk to Banff townsite' dropped (neighbouring Village I is given as 4.5 km from town).
Winter services not read (Banff winter camping page not found).
